notes:
Sales no longer fail on a Sell screen that has been left idle, or when several counters bill at once.
The Settings PIN prompt no longer blocks the rest of the app.
Settings now remembers your counter defaults: which mode Sell opens in, and the discounts that pre-fill on stock entry and on wholesale sales.
Adding stock pre-fills the cost and sell price for a medicine you already carry.
Shops set to wholesale now open the Customers page on its Wholesale tab.
